# xshield_segments (Data Source)

Segments matching a criteria, with their membership and automation settings.

The auto-sync modes are reported in the vocabulary you write, `test`, `enforce` or `disable`, rather than the `under-test` and `enforced` the API reads back.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "xshield_segments" "all" {}

# Segments whose auto-sync is enforcing rather than testing.
output "enforcing" {
  value = [
    for s in data.xshield_segments.all.segments : s.tag_based_policy_name
    if s.inbound_auto_sync_deployment_mode == "enforce"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `criteria` (String) Criteria selecting the segments. Defaults to every segment.
- `max_results` (Number) Stop after this many results. Left unset, every match is read. When a limit truncates the result set, `truncated` is true.

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) Ids of the matching segments, in the same order as the detailed list. Convenient for `for_each`.
- `segments` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--segments))
- `total` (Number) Total number of segments matching the criteria, as reported by the API.
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when `max_results` stopped the read before the end of the result set.

<a id="nestedatt--segments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `segments`

Read-Only:

- `criteria` (String) Criteria as stored, including the managedby clause the backend appends.
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `inbound_auto_sync_deployment_mode` (String) One of test, enforce or disable.
- `lowest_inbound_segment_asset_policy_status` (String) Inbound policy floor applied to members.
- `lowest_outbound_segment_asset_policy_status` (String) Outbound policy floor applied to members.
- `matching_assets` (Number) Assets currently in the segment.
- `namednetworks_assigned` (Number)
- `outbound_auto_sync_deployment_mode` (String) One of test, enforce or disable.
- `policy_automation_configurable` (Boolean)
- `tag_based_policy_name` (String)
- `templates_assigned` (Number)
